description: Election Commission - Declare that S. A. Sithy Rozan was selected as the member of the Akurana Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Akurana Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for local authorities, including the nomination and declaration of a selected member to fill a vacant position, which falls squarely under the Elections category (Type 7).
